stem: Julio's transition from the second paragraph (sentences 6–13) to the third paragraph (sentences 14–18) is weak. Which of the following could best replace sentence 14 and provide a more effective transition between these two paragraphs?

options.label: F
options.text: It's our job as young people to bring national attention to the crisis.

options.label: G
options.text: We need something to assist with the serious water crisis we are facing.

options.label: H
